name: waiting-entertainment-prototype
description: Clone-and-run local multiplayer waiting entertainment demo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n game,controller,host,broadcast,guest,server "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w player" "npm run dev -w host" "npm run dev -w screen" "npm run dev -w guest" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w player && npm run build -w host && npm run build -w screen && npm run build -w guest && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w @waiting/sea-battle
scripts.verify: npm run build && node server/test/runtime-manager-smoke.mjs && node server/test/game-registry-smoke.mjs && node server/test/game-settings-store.mjs && node client/test/platform-ui-contract.mjs
